Ah, there it is!\nThe "Snow Mist Jewel"!!\nIt's what I've been searching for all these years!
Ugh...I knew it wouldn't be so easy to get!
Zarth!
There are so many of them, pom!!
Ugh...looks like I have no choice!\nI'll protect Olant and Potumkin!\nYou handle that beast!!
Yes...!\nI finally got the "Snow Mist Jewel" I've been\nafter for so long!
But Zarth, what are you gonna use it for?
Hmm...Since you've been part of this journey,\nI'll tell you the truth. I need the jewel to save\nmy younger brother.
What?! Zarth, you have a younger brother, pom?!
Yeah. That's the reason I've been traveling\nthrough different worlds. With the "Snow Mist\nJewel", the potion to save Bemoz will be complete.
Bemoz? The one we met before?!\nSo, you're family?!\nAnd Bemoz isn't a woman, but a man?!
Yeah.\nBemoz is seriously ill. He was already sick even\nbefore I met Zoe...
I equipped him with a life-support device with a\ndefense system to prolong his life.
Alright, let's go to Deusania's Lab!\nThis should save Bemoz!
Oh, you made it!\nAh, I came to check on this guy cuz I'm kinda like\nthe manager of this villa.
By the way, perfect timing! This guy was supposed\nto be guarding this place, but it lost to you.\nCould you give it some proper training?
If it's strong enough to hold you in battle, then\nthis place will be completely safe.
Hm, I guess that's it.\nThanks!

So, I guess there are some things we can eat too~.\nIf I give them to Zoe, I think she'll make\ndifferent kinds of sweets for us...
